# Grey Ridge x402 Tools — full catalog (llms-full.txt)

> Keyless, pay-per-call APIs built for AI agents, billed in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402) — no
> account, no API key, no prepaid credits. A maintained multi-ATS jobs & hiring feed, live
> company/domain enrichment, email deliverability grading, Base-token pre-trade safety checks, and an
> MCP-server prompt-injection scanner. Most paid routes have a free preview that returns real output
> so an agent verifies quality before it pays. This file is the full, self-contained catalog: it
> carries enough to call every route without following a link. The short index is at
> https://rezearcher.github.io/greyridge-x402-tools/llms.txt

## How payment works (read once, applies to every paid route)

1. Call a paid route with an ordinary HTTP GET.
2. It answers `HTTP 402 Payment Required` with x402 v2 PaymentRequirements in BOTH the
   `payment-required` response header and the JSON body. The requirement is scheme `exact`, asset
   USDC, network `eip155:8453` (Base), amount in micro-USDC (6 decimals — e.g. 4000 = $0.004), and
   the `payTo` receiving address.
3. Pay with any x402 client (x402-fetch / x402-axios, or CDP/Coinbase x402 tooling) and retry the
   same request with the payment header. The route then returns the data.

Prices below are per call in USDC and were set from the live 402 responses. There is no signup,
no key, no minimum, and no prepaid balance — a funded Base wallet is the only requirement.

Honest limits, stated up front: the jobs/enrichment feeds are read live from each source on every
call (not a resold database), so breadth is the set of ATS platforms and domains you supply, not a
pre-crawled index of the whole web. Email verification is keyless (DoH) and does not perform an SMTP
mailbox probe. These trade-offs are intentional and described per product below.

## Jobs & hiring data (live, 10 ATS)

One normalized feed read live from each company's own applicant-tracking system — Greenhouse, Lever,
Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Recruitee, Workable, BambooHR, Breezy, Personio — with
company-domain auto-detection. Not a cached database: every call reads the board, so new / changed /
closed roles are current. Adapters are drift-monitored and maintained so the feed does not rot (a
schema-drift monitor grades each adapter REACHABLE / POPULATED / SCHEMA-INTACT against live canary
boards and opens a maintenance task on breakage).

- Job search — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/jobs/search — $0.004/call.
  Normalized postings across all 10 ATS, each with structured geography (location_parsed), canonical
  employment_type + seniority, and a ghost_candidate flag for likely-unfilled listings. Tunable
  ghost filtering (ghostDays / ghostOnly / excludeGhost) on the paid route.
- Hiring-intent signal — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/hiring/signal —
  $0.003/call. One buying-intent record per company: open-req count, intensity grade,
  department/location histograms, newest-post recency — for account scoring and trigger-based
  outreach.
- Compensation layer — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/jobs/comp —
  $0.005/call. Normalized {min,max,currency,period,annualized} salary per posting plus per-company
  disclosure rate and median band.
- Free preview — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/jobs/preview?companies=stripe.com
  — real sample rows teasing all three paid products for one company, no payment.

Explainers: live-greenhouse-jobs-api, ghost-job-detection-api, salary-data-api-x402,
hiring-intent-signal-api, ats-jobs-api-x402, fantastic-jobs-alternative (honest head-to-head: resold
enriched database vs. a live board read with change tracking), ats-jobs-scraper-comparison (honest
coverage comparison, 10 vs 6 vs 1 ATS), connect-jobs-mcp-server — all under
https://rezearcher.github.io/greyridge-x402-tools/

## Company & domain enrichment

Enrich a company domain with one live-from-source record — no resold database; you enrich the
domains you supply.

- Company enrichment — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/company/enrich —
  $0.01/company. One firmographic record per domain: site-crawl (name / industry / description /
  social / contacts), tech-stack fingerprint, keyless DNS/RDAP depth (email provider, SaaS-from-DNS,
  domain age + registrar) and the live multi-ATS hiring block.
- Free preview — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/company/enrich/preview?companies=stripe.com
  — the keyless DNS/RDAP layer on one domain, no payment.

Explainers: company-enrichment-api, detect-saas-tech-stack-from-domain (reads live DNS
domain-verification tokens + SPF chain, surfacing back-office SaaS a crawl-based detector like
BuiltWith or Wappalyzer cannot see), flag-risky-domains-lead-quality-api (score a lead / sign-up
domain by real registration age, registrar and mail setup from RDAP/DNS).

## Email deliverability & verification

- Email verification — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/email/verify —
  $0.002/email. One deliverability record per address: MX / implicit-MX routing, SPF + DMARC posture,
  disposable / role / free-provider flags against a loop-maintained throwaway-domain corpus, a
  derived typo "did-you-mean", and an A–F grade. Keyless (DoH), no SMTP mailbox probe.
- Free preview — GET https://assetfactory-jobs-x402.sigrunner.workers.dev/email/verify/preview?emails=test@stripe.com
  — the first email graded in full, no payment.

Explainer: email-verification-deliverability-api — honest head-to-head with the SMTP list-cleaners
(ZeroBounce, NeverBounce, Kickbox): where a mailbox SMTP probe is the right tool, and where a
deliverability + domain-risk + sender-posture grade an agent can call with nothing but a wallet fits
instead.

## Base token safety (pre-trade checks for trading agents)

- Token report — GET https://x402-data-api.sigrunner.workers.dev/chain/token-report — $0.01/token.
  Honeypot sell-simulation, proxy / mint / pause / blacklist flags, measured transfer tax, liquidity
  depth; returns SAFE / CAUTION / AVOID.
- Swap guard — GET https://x402-data-api.sigrunner.workers.dev/gate/swap — $0.008/call. Returns
  GO / HOLD / BLOCK for a proposed swap.

Explainers: token-rug-checks, honeypot-check-api-base, pre-trade-safety-gate-ai-agents,
base-token-safety-price-comparison, x402-token-risk-api.

## MCP server security scanner

- Scan an MCP server — GET https://x402-data-api.sigrunner.workers.dev/scan/mcp — $0.05/scan. Static
  tool-poisoning / prompt-injection scan of advertised MCP metadata (OWASP LLM01 / LLM08), itemized
  findings; never invokes a tool. Also a free CLI:
  `npx -y github:rezearcher/greyridge-x402-tools mcpscan <server-url>` (exit code 2 on `block` for CI).

Explainers: scan-mcp-server-prompt-injection, claude-connector-directory-readiness,
mcp-server-scorecards.
